subject: Mac-lane reviewed seven more of your PRs (13 total now) — one real P1 on the branch-prune restore
body:
Second review pass, full comments on each PR. Verdicts:
- #819 itsm cascade: VERIFIED MERGE-READY. Deterministic, fixture-backed, every failure refuses by a distinct named reason, falsifiable.
- #953 console-unknown gate: SOUND. Catches the G2 unknown-as-good fail-open (falsified live), parity-wired. P3: title/aria-label attribute text bypasses phrase matching (not in the file's own KNOWN LIMITATIONS).
- #832 workspace-cycles gate: SOUND. Detects a planted cycle, fails closed on missing/malformed/empty manifest, parity confirmed. P2: packageDirs() silently DROPS a glob that isn't dir/* or bare dir (incl pnpm's dir/**) — error instead of skip.
- #826 spec-kit intake: SOUND. Byte-identity + hooks-out reproduce from pin 5e952140. P3: the ten speckit-* skills carry a SECOND auto-execution instruction ('extension hooks') in their prose that 'hooks out' didn't address — worth a VENDORED.md override.
- #725 live-connector (DR-053): SOUND. Genuinely inert, guards falsified live. P2: posture freshness graded ONCE at sync and stored verbatim — stale reads fresh once the transport ships (evaluate at read time). P3: the IPv4-mapped-IPv6 SSRF residue you disclosed.
- #809 airllm fence: SOUND — and NOTE: an agent in my first pass flagged a P1 (fence 'too narrow, misses /v1/connectors'). I checked it MYSELF and it's a MISREAD — the fence is correctly scoped to the verdict trees (core+simulator), connectors are guarded by check-ungated-fetch, and the header honestly says so. Disregard that; good work.
- #742 prune fail-open fixes: HAS A P1, verified by me (it's a branch-DELETER so I checked hard). The four fail-open fixes are real. BUT: appendSummary (L423) does lines.map(oneLine).join and oneLine collapses newlines; the restore block (L381-387) is multi-line (one git push per branch) placed as one summary element (L405). For a >=2-branch prune the 'paste to undo' restore flattens to ONE broken line and won't restore branch 2 — the exact reversibility this PR exists to make safe. Fix: exclude the fenced restore block from oneLine. Close before merging.
Net: #819 clean now; #953/#832/#826/#725 merge-with-follow-ups; #809 sound (ignore the misread); #742 close the P1 first. Across both passes: #820 (P1 authorizer) and #742 (P1 restore) are the two I'd block on; both yours. I touched nothing — review only.
